_provenance.model: values read from SupplyChainData / SupplyChainSimulation / SafetyStockStrategy

scenarios.name: ACCURATE_Tron baseline
scenarios.description: No disruption, no resilience strategy: (s,S) with kappa = 8 weeks, triangular demand, lost sales — the syn_effect baseline.

scenarios.name: ACCURATE_Tron disruption — SUP-096 (multi-sourced A)
scenarios.description: Supplier SUP-096 delivers nothing for 8 weeks (the mean of the study's U{5..10}). The study starts it at week 85-87 after a cold start; the engine warm-starts at S_m, so it is placed at week 12, inside the 52-week analysis window.
